# section of the error-handling specification. GENERATED by
# scripts/regen-diagnostic-codes.sh from the runtime_diagnostic_code!
# literals in the sources; do not hand-edit.

# These are the codes a RUN records durably and `expect diagnostic` matches
# against. They carry no coverage column: this repository has no corpus that
# drives a runtime plane the way examples/*.whip drives `whip check`, so
# claiming coverage here would be a claim rather than a measurement.
